CITY BASED HOMELESS PLAN STANDING COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  TEMPLE CITY, CALIFORNIA

  JULY 9, 2026, 2:00 P.M.

  CITY HALL CONFERENCE ROOM
  9701 LAS TUNAS DRIVE, TEMPLE CITY

PROCEDURE TO ADDRESS HOMELESSNESS STANDING COMMITTEE:

•  AGENDA ITEM: at the time the Standing Committee consider the agenda item;

•  NON-AGENDA ITEM: at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while
  the Standing Committee values your comments, pursuant to the Brown Act, the
  Council cannot take action on any item not listed on the agenda.

WRITTEN COMMENT

Written public comments received on the day of the meeting will be provided to the
standing committee and made part of the meeting record. Written public comments will
not be read aloud by city staff or the standing committee.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to
participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk at (626) 285-2171. Notification
48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to
ensure accessibility to this meeting.
